QF.id: XVI Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_2

question.text: The first principle in the SEBI Code of Conduct for brokers is:

answer.text: Integrity — maintaining high standards of integrity, promptitude and fairness
Market share — expanding the client base rapidly
Risk-taking — encouraging clients to take more risks

explanation.text: The Logic: Integrity is the first listed principle in the SEBI Code of Conduct for brokers. Brokers shall maintain high standards of integrity, promptitude, and fairness in the conduct of their business, and shall not indulge in manipulation or malpractice. The Trap: The first principle is not framed around profitability, market share, or risk-taking — those goals must operate within the integrity, promptitude, and fairness framework. Note: The source language stresses integrity, promptitude, fairness, and avoidance of manipulation/malpractice; specific examples like front-running or cherry-picking are not used on the cited page.
